questions.request: Identify the endpoint, route, HTTP action, and ShareLinkViewSet operation that accepts creation of a share for an existing document. Trace the request into the viewset and identify any inherited endpoint-level authentication, permission, queryset, or object-resolution controls that apply before share creation.
questions.principal: The authenticated caller requesting creation of a share for an existing document.
questions.resource: The share-creation operation and the existing document selected as the document to be shared.
questions.operation: Invoke the share-creation endpoint and begin creating a ShareLink associated with the selected document.
questions.entryHint: Search src/documents views, serializers, permissions, and src/paperless/urls.py for ShareLinkViewSet, its create action, routing, and inherited framework controls.

premises.text: A principal asks to share an existing document.
The review must determine which endpoint and object controls apply to that exact document before the share is created.
Do not assume that document existence or a global model permission grants access to this document.

questions.request: Determine how the exact document named by the share-create request is resolved and whether authorization is checked against that document object before the ShareLink is created. Identify the trusted decision point and whether the check is object-specific rather than based only on an identifier or document existence.
questions.principal: The authenticated caller, treated as lower trust than the document authorization boundary.
questions.resource: The exact existing document referenced by the request and its document-level access policy.
questions.operation: Authorize sharing of that document as part of creating a ShareLink.
questions.entryHint: Trace the document identifier from ShareLinkViewSet input through lookup, queryset filtering, object retrieval, permission checks, and the create/save path in src/documents.

premises.text: The caller must be authorized for the exact shared document, not merely for a document identifier supplied in the request.
Knowing a document ID alone is insufficient.
A global add_sharelink permission is insufficient unless the exact-document view requirement is also enforced.

questions.request: Trace all inherited permission paths relevant to ShareLinkViewSet creation, including framework permission classes, viewset base classes, action-specific permission selection, queryset restrictions, and any document/object permission helpers. State which controls are endpoint-wide and which, if any, bind the caller to the exact document.
questions.principal: The authenticated caller attempting the share creation action.
questions.resource: The ShareLink creation endpoint, the ShareLink object being created, and the exact source document.
questions.operation: Pass all inherited and explicit authorization gates for the create action.
questions.entryHint: Inspect ShareLinkViewSet inheritance and permission-related methods, then follow referenced permission and document-access code under src/documents.

premises.text: Relevant inherited permission paths must be included in the determination.
A global model permission must not be treated as proof of access to the exact document.
The current policy requires view_document permission for the exact shared document.

questions.request: Trace the serializer path used by ShareLinkViewSet creation, including field definitions, document relation handling, validation, create or update methods, and any serializer-context or request-aware authorization logic. Determine whether the serializer merely accepts or resolves the document, or enforces view_document permission for that exact document before persistence.
questions.principal: The authenticated caller supplying share-creation input through the API.
questions.resource: The serializer input and the exact document relation on the ShareLink that will be persisted.
questions.operation: Validate and serialize request data for creation of a document share.
questions.entryHint: Follow ShareLinkViewSet serializer selection and the relevant serializer/serialiser classes, relation fields, validate methods, and create methods under src/documents.

premises.text: The serializer path is relevant to whether the exact-document authorization requirement is enforced before the share is created.
Document existence, relation resolution, and serializer acceptance are not by themselves proof of document-level authorization.

questions.request: Compare the traced source behavior with the independently supplied current policy. Decide whether the create flow requires view_document permission for the exact shared document, whether any add_sharelink or equivalent global permission is only supplemental, and whether an unauthorized caller could create a share based only on document existence or a supplied document ID. Explain the compliance result using source evidence without inventing deployment behavior.
questions.principal: A caller requesting to create a share, including a caller who may have global share-link creation permission but lacks view_document permission for the target document.
questions.resource: The exact document and the newly created share link associated with it.
questions.operation: Create a share for the document under the current authorization policy.
questions.entryHint: Reconcile the endpoint, inherited permission, object-resolution, and serializer traces from src/documents and src/paperless/urls.py with the supplied policy.

premises.text: A caller creating a document share must have view_document permission for the exact shared document.
A global add_sharelink permission or knowing a document ID alone is insufficient.
The result must explain source behavior and policy compliance, not assume undocumented provider, proxy, deployment, or identity controls.

questions.request: List the specific unresolved facts needed to complete the conformance determination, distinguishing source-visible facts from facts absent from the supplied source or dependent on runtime configuration. For each missing fact, state why it matters and give a narrow owner-observable or local source-validation plan; do not turn an unverified hypothesis into a confirmed conclusion.
questions.principal: The reviewer and system owner responsible for confirming the caller's effective permissions and the deployed request path.
questions.resource: The exact target document, caller identity and permissions, route configuration, inherited controls, serializer behavior, and share-creation transaction.
questions.operation: Close or document the remaining authorization-conformance gaps for share creation.
questions.entryHint: Use the source trace to identify concrete unknowns, especially effective caller permissions, object-level permission implementation/configuration, route inclusion, and any runtime controls not represented under the allowed paths.

premises.text: The inquiry must explain specific missing facts.
Do not assume document existence or a global model permission grants access to the exact document.
Facts not present in the supplied source must remain explicitly unresolved rather than guessed.

policy.text: A caller creating a document share must have view_document permission for the exact shared document. A global add_sharelink permission or knowing a document ID alone is insufficient.
